messages:
PagerDuty: Incident triggered - traces-export-errors on prod (sev2) :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Alert: OTLP exporter _honeycomb_ returning 502s; 45% of trace batches failing over last 5m
Jing: I'm on it, picking up pager. Seeing a spike of `export_failed` in tracer logs.
Jing: quick check - are logs showing Honeycomb 502 or OTLP gateway timeouts?
Sara: Logs show 502 from honeycomb.us gateway. Sample from pod:
```
2025-06-07T12:13:22Z ERROR exporter/otlp: export failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = 502 Bad Gateway
```
Michael: Confirmed from infra side - our egress NLB has healthy targets; nothing else failing. Could be Honeycomb-side incident.
OTLP-Agent: (automated) otlp_exporter_retries=3 backoff=200ms
Carolina: Paging Honeycomb support and checking status.honeycomb.io
Jing: Mitigation plan: 1) Enable disk buffer at tracer side 2) Reduce trace sampling for non-prod and low-value traces 3) Switch exporter to our backup (internal s3-archive) for persistence
Sara: How urgent is customer-facing impact? Metrics still OK, requests not failing.
Jing: Impact: tracing gaps for spans exported after ~12:05 UTC, tracing UI may show missing spans or partial traces for affected services. No request latencies or errors reported yet. Customers relying on live traces may see gaps.
Michael: Working on a k8s rollout to flip exporter. Command will be:
```
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/tracer TRACER_EXPORT_MODE=backup_s3 --record
```
Sara: I'll prepare a temporary sampling override: set TRACING_SAMPLING_RATE=0.02 for frontend and workers.
Carolina: Honeycomb status responded: "investigating" on their side, possible gateway routing issue. ETA unknown.
Jing: Implementing disk buffering now. Pushing config map change:
```
otlp.buffer.enabled=true
otlp.buffer.path=/var/lib/otlp-buffer
otlp.buffer.max_size_mb=1024
```
Michael: Rolling change to exporter fallback in canary then global. Can someone watch traces while I flip canary?
Sara: I'll watch. Also adding a temporary alert to avoid noise once buffer kicks in: otlp_export_fail_rate > 10% for 5m
OTLP-Agent: (note) while buffering enabled, exporter latency may increase; batches will queue to disk.
Carolina: Notifying CS - customer advisory draft:
"We are experiencing trace export interruptions to Honeycomb affecting live trace visibility. No request-level service degradation. We are enacting fallback buffering and will update when honeycomb resolves the upstream issue."
Jing: On-call handoff in 45m -> Michael will take primary after I brief him. I'll capture actions and follow-ups.
Michael: Acknowledged, will take post-handoff monitoring and liaise with Honeycomb.
Sara: Done sampling override and watching traffic. Trace volume dropped ~80%.
Michael: Canary exporter switch complete. Canary traces now stored to our s3-archive. No data loss so far. :thumbsup:
Jing: Good. Next: - Create incident ticket ID INC-20250607-01 - Postmortem owner: Jing - Follow-ups: update runbook for exporter-fallback, add automated buffer enable on repeated exporter 5xx
Carolina: Also add test for exporter failover in chaos tests.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Jing, escalated to SRE and Infra.
Jing: Handing off to Michael in 10m. Final note: customers who need immediate trace access can request reingest from s3-archive once Honeycomb resumes.
Michael: Taking over. Monitoring dashboards pinned. Will update thread if Honeycomb posts ETA or when we switch back.
Jing: Thanks team. :heart:
